prompt:
Create one landscape 3:2 MOOD BOARD for a vanilla Minecraft 1.21.1 building kit titled "PRESIDIO • SAN FRANCISCO". Plain warm light background, crisp voxel blocks, restrained architectural presentation, no characters, villagers, animals, vehicles, watermark, or photorealistic geometry. All construction must be plausible vanilla Minecraft blocks, stairs, slabs, fences and trapdoors. This is a mood board for the whole eight-module historic military post kit, not just a single mansion.

LAYOUT: upper two thirds contain FOUR clearly separated small isometric thumbnail takes on the COMPLETE eight-building kit: one larger primary ensemble and three smaller alternatives, each showing the eight distinct complete modules. Vary roof massing, porch arrangement and building articulation across the takes while preserving each module's identity. Show fronts and side walls, finished roofs and rear returns. Label the four takes "A • POST QUARTERS", "B • MISSION COURT", "C • PARADE ROW", "D • COASTAL POST". Use tiny numbered labels 0–7 on the main kit. These are separate building models on minimal individual smooth-stone bases, not buildings on a giant paved site. A few detached voxel cypress and eucalyptus silhouette studies may flank the compositions to establish Presidio character, outside the actual module plots. Maintain ample visual breathing room.

BUILDING BRIEF, shared by all four takes: Presidio of San Francisco, old US Army post at the south end of the Golden Gate Bridge. Tidy historic officers' and family housing, utilitarian outbuildings, barracks, hall and Endicott coastal battery. White and cream painted wood/stucco, clay red and slate grey roofs, dark green or white trim, brick chimneys, sheltered porches. Complete freestanding small buildings finished on all sides, centered on their real footprint. Scale 0.5 blocks per metre: a storey about 2 blocks, single-block windows, roofs made of stairs and slabs. Render visibly SMALL block counts, not enormous detailed buildings. Front doors on south/high z, north arrow on primary thumbnail. Concealed sea lantern lighting or lanterns under porches and interior lights prevent mob spawns. No building or eave may cross its plot or height limit. Each ground course is one block of smooth stone at y=0, only beneath the building and at most a one-block apron, remaining plot area unfilled.

Main kit modules laid out in x order, with z extending north-to-south:
0 FAMILY HOUSE, x0..7 z0..7, 8x8, max y8: two storeys, white clapboard represented by birch and white concrete/smooth quartz, steep red stair roof, south porch, brick chimney.
1 DUPLEX, x8..17 z0..9, 10x10, max y8: cream stucco, hipped red clay-tile effect using brick and polished granite stairs with terracotta, Mission Revival silhouette, two south entrances.
2 GARAGE, x18..23 z0..5, 6x6, max y5: single storey, white walls, dark grey gabled roof, wide south garage door represented by white trapdoors.
3 SHED, x24..27 z0..3, 4x4, max y4: tiny white utility shed/kiosk, simple dark roof.
4 BARRACKS / OFFICE, x28..43 z0..13, 16x14, max y9: long two-storey red-brown brick block, white trim, grey slate-effect stair roof, south colonnaded porch.
5 HALL, x44..63 z0..19, 20x20, max y10: larger Spanish Colonial Revival cream stucco hall, red tiled stair roof, voxel stepped arched windows, modest bell tower/cupola.
6 OFFICERS' HOUSE, x64..75 z0..11, 12x12, max y8: two storeys white wood, green shutters made of spruce trapdoors with green terracotta accents, grey roof with small dormers, wide south porch.
7 COASTAL GUN BATTERY, x76..93 z0..23, 18x24, max y5: low weathered concrete Endicott-era emplacement; smooth stone, light gray concrete, andesite, cracked stone bricks. Two circular stepped gun pits with iron mounting rings represented by iron bars/trapdoors, no oversized artillery. Grass earth embankment on seaward north side slopes up to parapet, south rear wall has ammunition room iron doors, stairs to parapet, rusty streaks using granite and terracotta. Show both pits clearly from above and rear doors from the south.

BOTTOM STRIP: a clean compact materials library with actual voxel swatches grouped by roles, every swatch has its EXACT Minecraft block id lettered legibly beneath it. Use these IDs verbatim, no invented blocks:
WALLS: minecraft:white_concrete ; minecraft:birch_planks ; minecraft:smooth_sandstone ; minecraft:bricks
TRIM: minecraft:smooth_quartz ; minecraft:spruce_trapdoor
ROOF: minecraft:brick_stairs ; minecraft:polished_granite_stairs ; minecraft:deepslate_tile_stairs
WINDOWS: minecraft:glass_pane
ACCENTS: minecraft:green_terracotta ; minecraft:iron_bars ; minecraft:lantern
BATTERY: minecraft:light_gray_concrete ; minecraft:andesite ; minecraft:cracked_stone_bricks
Use small precise dark sans-serif lettering, sufficient space so IDs are not clipped. Only real 1.21.1 materials, no pale oak, no terracotta stairs (they do not exist).

Between thumbnails and swatch strip include FOUR close-up voxel detail callouts, with thin leader lines and concise labels: "RED EAVE + BRICK CHIMNEY" showing stepped red stair eave and little brick chimney on white wall; "GREEN SHUTTERS + PORCH" showing a one-block glazed window with dark spruce trapdoor shutters, green accent and white porch post; "MISSION ARCH + CUPOLA" showing stepped arch and small bell opening built of blocks; "BATTERY PIT + REAR DOORS" showing circular iron mounting ring, stained concrete, parapet stair and south ammunition door. Detail callouts must keep the same coarse miniature scale as the buildings. The final sheet should read immediately as a coherent historic Presidio kit with varied roofs and silhouettes, not one recolored box.
reads: White clapboard and cream stucco buildings among tall cypress and spreading eucalyptus.
Red tiled roofs, stepped eaves, and brick chimneys on the family housing.
Cream duplex with a hipped red roof and paired porch entrances.
Small white garage and utility shed with dark gabled roofs.
Long red-brick barracks with white trim and a colonnaded porch.
Spanish Revival hall with arched windows, red roof, and a small cupola.
White officers’ house with green shutters, grey dormered roof, and wide porch.
Low concrete coastal battery with twin round gun pits, iron rings, rear doors, parapet stairs, rust stains, and a grassy embankment.
